name: Pleiad (Hesperid Queen)
body:
Pleiad
CR 20

A tall and majestic woman looks at you, sunlight and starlight dancing in her eyes and hair, her skin as pale as starry twilight.

XP 307,200
LG Medium fey
Init +12; Senses low-light vision; Perception +51
Aura luminous beauty (30 ft.)

DEFENSE

AC 36, touch 26, flat-footed 27 (+7 deflection, +8 Dex, +1 dodge, +10 natural)
Hp 351 (37d6+222); fast healing 5
Fort +18, Ref +28, Will +27
Defensive Abilities sunlight sustenance; DR 10/cold iron; Immune blindness, dazzling effects; Resist acid 30, electricity 30, fire 30
Weaknesses sunlight dependent

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee sunset ribbon +26/+21/+16/+11 (1d3+1, +1d6 divine, +1d6 fire)
Special Attacks blinding flash 10/day (10 rounds, DC 27), nimbus of light 20 rounds/day
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 37th; concentration +44)

Constant—light (self only)
At will—dancing lights, harvest season, tongues, tree shape
8/day—rebuke death (1d4+10)
5/day—beguiling gift (DC 18), plant growth, sending (hesperides only), wall of light (DC 22)
3/day—animate plants, breath of life, unbearable brightness
1/day—summon (level 9, 1 mature adult solar dragon 100%), true resurrection

Cleric Spells Prepared (CL 20th; concentration +27)

9th Level—ascension, mass heal, miracle (DC 28), overwhelming presence (DC 28), prismatic sphereD
8th Level—euphoric tranquility (DC 27), fire storm (DC 27), greater angelic aspect, holy aura (DC 27), sunburstD (DC 27)
7th Level—archon’s trumpet (DC 26), holy word (DC 26), hymn of peace (DC 26), morning sun (DC 26), repulsion (DC 26), sunbeamD (DC 26)
6th Level—animate objects, chains of light (DC 25), fire seedsD (DC 25), music of the spheres, planar ally, symbol of persuasion (DC 25)
5th Level—cleansing fire, flame strikeD (DC 24), greater command (DC 24), hallow (DC 24), pillar of life, sacred nimbus
4th Level—brightest light, burst with light (DC 23), divination, fire shieldD, healing flames (DC 23), holy smite (DC 23)
3rd Level—continual flame, create food and water, daylightd, glyph of warding (DC 22), magic vestment, prayer, searing light
2nd Level—burst of radiance (DC 21), calm emotions (DC 21), eagle’s splendor, enthrall (DC 21), fear the sun (DC 19), heat metalD, sun’s disdain (DC 19)
1st Level—bless, celestial healing, faerie fireD, positive pulse, protection from evil, sanctuary (DC 20), sun metal
0-Level—guidance, light, purify food and drink, spark

Domains Healing, Sun/Light

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 26, Con 22, Int 20, Wis 24, Cha 25
Base Atk +18: CMB +26; CMD 37
Feats Agile Maneuvers, Alertness, Brew Potion, Combat Casting, Cultivate Magic Plants, Craft Wondrous Item, Dodge, Flaring Spell, Greater Spell Focus (Abjuration, Conjuration, Enchantment, Evocation), Improved Initiative, Solar Spell C&C, Spell Focus (Abjuration, Conjuration, Evocation, Enchantment), Weapon Finesse
Skills Craft (clothing) +45, Diplomacy +47, Knowledge (geography, nature) +45, Knowledge (planes, religion) +42, Perception +51, Perform (dance, sing) +47, Sense Motive +51, Use Magic Device +47
Languages Celestial, Common, Sylvan; tongues
SQ improved create golden apple, divine grace, healer’s blessing

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Divine Grace (Su)

A pleiad adds her Charisma modifier as a deflection bonus to her armor class.

Improved Create Golden Apple (Su)

As a standard action, a pleiad can condense the light around her to create a perfect golden apple. This can function as an alluring golden appleue, a healthy apple from a charm bracelet, or an apple of eternal sleep, at the pleiad’s choice. It is consumed once used.

Once per day, the pleiad can also cast sympathy on a golden apple she creates; this apple is not consumed until the spell’s duration expires. All the negative effects of a golden apple can be negated by succeeding at a DC 35 Will save. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Luminous Beauty (Su)

This ability affects all humanoids within 30 feet of a pleiad. Those who look directly at a pleiad must succeed on a DC 35 Fortitude save or be stunned for 1d10 rounds. A pleiad can suppress or resume this ability as a free action. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Spells Pleiades cast spells as 20th-level clerics, and have access to two domains (typically Healing and Sun or any of their subdomains), gaining domain spells and domain powers as normal. They can also swap out prepared spells to cast cure spells as clerics.

Sunlight Dependent (Su)

A pleiad draws her power and health from sunlight and starlight. A pleiad that is not exposed to natural light for 24 hours takes 1d6 points of Constitution damage, and another 1d6 points of Constitution damage every day that follows- eventually, this privation kills the nymph. This effect is stopped as soon as the pleiad can see the sun or stars again.

Sunlight Sustenance (Ex)

A pleiad doesn’t need to breathe, eat, or sleep as long as she is exposed to sunlight or starlight.

Sunset Ribbon (Su)

At will, a pleiad can harden part of the diaphanous veils she wears to use as a shield or whip, as silk to steelum. When used as a whip, the veil is considered a holy weapon, except half the additional damage it deals is divine damage, and the other half is fire damage. Targets suffer this additional damage even if they would not be normally damaged by a whip attack.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate and warm coasts, islands, and oases, or outer space
Organization solitary, retinue (1 plus 1–10 hesperides), or court (1 plus 2–16 fauns, 2–20 hesperides, 2–12 pegasi, and 1–2 cloud giants)
Treasure triple (ambrosial lotus, goodberry bush, tree of knowledge, other treasure)

Pleiades are the sovereigns of hesperides, nourished by the light of many suns on a world or between worlds. They keep court in the same remote realms and islands as their lesser sisters, guarding many magical plants and fruits that can be used to boost their allies in battle or, rarely, be gifted to worthy mortals or deities; but a solitary pleiad can also be found to travel through space, visiting different stars and planets to sooth her everlasting thirst for beauty and knowledge. Pleiades are the most knowledgeable of all nymphs, and are sought both by heroes and scholars for information and wisdom that few other beings in existence could impart.
